pairs.question: Quid prodest noctu formosas esse puellas?
pairs.answer: Saepe fuit iuvenis credita turpis anus.
pairs.derivation: Within Puella in Amatorem the speaker poses a rhetorical question (line 7) and answers it herself in the following pentameter (line 8): the worth of nighttime beauty is nullified because in the dark an ugly old woman has often passed for a young one. Question is the full hexameter; answer is the full pentameter, which directly resolves the question. Inline scaffolding (none present mid-line here) and the title/section/footer lines were excluded. Other interrogatives in this poem (cur me nocte petis...?, Forsitan... horres?) and in 1.4 are unanswered rhetorical pleas in a continuous monologue and were dropped.
